description: Search 1,492 studio-filmed exercises. Every filter is optional and they combine. Only exercises returned here exist: never invent an exercise or an id. Without q the order is alphabetical, so filter rather than page.

equipment.description: The gear the person HAS (bodyweight is always allowed); exercises needing anything else are left out. Values from get_vocabulary.

excludeJoints.description: Leave out anything that loads these joints, e.g. a sore knee. Values from get_vocabulary.

muscle.description: Primary or secondary muscles. Values from get_vocabulary.

q.description: Text in the name, French name or aliases, e.g. 'goblet squat'

name: search_exercises
title: Search ExerciseBank exercises
